Keysight Technologies Inc operates within the Technology sector and reported revenue of 1846000000.00 for the latest quarter ended 2026-07-31 [D1]. The company posted net income of 397000000.00 with earnings per share of 2.82, reflecting a year-over-year growth rate of 0.639535 for the quarter and 1.078534 for net income [D1]. Management raised its full-year outlook citing record results driven by AI infrastructure demand and strong performance in both Communications Solutions Group and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group [D3]. The stock closed at 333.42 with a forward price to earnings ratio of 20.6612 and a trailing price to earnings ratio of 45.8862 [Facts].

Analysts have set a mean price target of 418.42, indicating a potential upside from the current trading level [D5]. The company expects fourth quarter revenue in the range of 1930000000 to 1950000000 with non-GAAP earnings per share between 3.34 and 3.40 [D1]. Management noted that supply chain constraints will act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion for the next several quarters despite high demand [D4]. The company also announced participation in investor conferences scheduled for 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-15 [D6].

Keysight Technologies Inc serves technology innovators as a mission-critical design enablement partner for the world's most complex engineering challenges [D1]. The company reported orders of 2091000000.00 which were up 56 percent on a reported basis [D3]. Revenue from the Communications Solutions Group was 1345000000.00 while revenue from the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group was 501000000.00 [D1]. The company ended the quarter with cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash totaling 2622000000.00 [D1].

The market is arguing about whether demand durability will be sustainable given supply constraints that are less flexible today than a year ago [D3]. Analysts have expressed optimism over the company's earnings prospects as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates higher [D5]. The company expects fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 32 percent and EPS growth of approximately 60 percent at the midpoint [D3]. Management stated that the supply environment is less flexible today than a year ago and requires deeper engagement with suppliers to deconstrain production [D4].
